name: thin-features-refresh-fs
description: Refresh the THIN feature source (dev/fixtures-capture/thin-native-features.fs) into the 'Thin Native Features' Feature Studio of the OPEN document, so the thin rows already inserted recompute from the edited source and a NEW thin feature (Thin Variable) becomes offered by the workspace custom-feature dropdown. apply=false: this project creates no document, adds no feature row and creates no version, so the target's feature tree keeps exactly the rows it had. feature_studio_tab names the studio explicitly, because browser_deploy_featurescript writes whichever editor is on screen and would clobber a different studio if the wrong tab were active. The deploy step reads the source from disk, so the committed bytes are the packaged file, not a transcription. The runner cannot report this step as ok: TOOL_OUTCOME_KEYS requires 'built' from browser_deploy_and_apply_featurescript, and an apply=false call builds nothing; success is verified afterwards with browser_get_fs_compile_status (compiled true, 0 blocking notices), browser_read_featurescript (sha matches the file on disk) and a fresh STEP export.
